fix_plan.description: Fixes double discount deduction by applying the discount only once to the subtotal.

files_to_modify.original_code:
# BUG (INC-002): Discount is mistakenly subtracted twice from subtotal
    discounted_subtotal = max(0.0, (subtotal - discount) - discount)
files_to_modify.fixed_code:
# BUG (INC-002): Discount is mistakenly subtracted twice from subtotal
    discounted_subtotal = max(0.0, subtotal - discount)
files_to_modify.rationale: Replacing the erroneous expression with a single subtraction ensures the discount is applied only once, correcting the total calculation.
